_about: The tracker's one-point seven-day steps as its committed passive-history files held them on each snapshot date, all four accounts, timestamps in UTC. Token lists are [input, output, cache_read, cache_write, cache_write_1h] per model id (cache_write_1h is inside cache_write). headless_tokens is a claude -p run's own turns; null where the collector recorded no split. clean marks the steps the publisher fits on (weekly_meter.clean_steps: no harness run, no cloud session, no non-accepted stretch). regime_edges are the 14 September cut and each model family's first use (credits.change_candidates). five_hour_windows are the recorded five-hour windows (end, five-hour percent).
